**P2 Do not treat a CI guard as preventing repository state**

When a change reaches `main` through the documented Replit direct-push path, GitHub Actions runs only after the change has landed (`docs/ai-context/replit-environment.md:175-180`), so a build-failing guard merely detects invalid repository contents on that path. territory.note: Territory is mechanical (finding path vs. this PR's changed files). CAUSE (new-ground / propagation / wrong-fix / re-raised) is NOT derivable -- it has no machine-readable marker, and is deliberately left unclassified rather than guessed.

sinceLastReview.reason: snapshot carries no pr.head.sha, so the diff has no verifiable endpoint
sinceLastReview.note: Branch movement since the last reviewed commit -- NOT the PR's diff. After a merge from the base branch this includes files already reviewed and merged there. Use `artifact` for the size of what is actually under review here.
